Upload ETABS "Story Stiffness" Table

Export the Story Stiffness table from ETABS (Display → Show Tables, or Excel export) as a .xlsx file — same format as an ETABS database table — and upload it below. The tool will average Stiff X / Stiff Y across all analysis steps for each story and run the BNBC 2020 / ASCE 7-05 Soft-Storey and Extreme Soft-Storey Irregularity checks in both directions.

X-Direction

Y-Direction

Ki/Ki+1 > 0.7 (Soft-Storey) / >= 0.6 (Extreme) checks stiffness against the story immediately above. Ki/Kmi >= 0.8 (Soft-Storey) / >= 0.7 (Extreme) checks stiffness against the average of the 3 stories above, per BNBC 2020 / ASCE 7-05 vertical structural irregularity provisions. Based on the "Soft story X & Y Direction" calculation sheet.

0Beam objects
0ETABS station rows
+20%Current reinforcement addition
Upload any ETABS beam design Excel .xlsx / .xls — sheet name fixed হওয়া প্রয়োজন নেই। Header-এ Story, Label, Station, AsTopTotal/AsTop এবং AsBotTotal/AsBot থাকলে tool নিজে table খুঁজে নেবে।
Calculation method, assumptions and +% application
Adjusted As = ETABS Required As × (1 + Additional % / 100). 20% select করলে ETABS-এর 500 mm² demand 600 mm² ধরে bar count করা হবে।
Top straight = middle-zone top demand; left/right top extra = support demand minus provided straight bar area. Bottom straight = দুই support-এর বড় bottom demand; middle bottom extra = middle demand minus provided bottom straight area.
এটি automatic detailing suggestion। Development length, anchorage, lap, curtailment, seismic detailing, stirrup/shear design, clear spacing এবং constructability final drawing-এর আগে qualified structural engineer দিয়ে যাচাই করতে হবে।
ETABS beam design Excel upload করলে এখানে beam-wise schedule দেখা যাবে।

Combined Total (All Marks)

Beam

Straight Bars (full length)
Extra Bars (at supports)
Extra Top/Bottom lengths follow standard BNBC/ACI curtailment guidance (Exterior support L/4, Interior support L/3, Extra Bottom 70–75% of clear span). This does not add the extra development length (Ld) / hook length into the column at exterior supports — add that manually to the length field if needed.

Slab

Main Bar (cranked / alternate bar system)
Runs across the Width, spaced along the Length. Of the total bars, alternate bars are cranked (bent up near supports) to serve as the negative-moment (top) steel — so no separate "extra top" bars are needed in this direction. The other half stay straight along the bottom.
Distribution Bar (top steel only, at supports)
Runs across the Length, spaced along the Width — placed only near the supports as negative-moment steel (no bottom mesh role here, since the cranked Main bars already cover the bottom). Length is curtailed to a fraction of its own span (Length).

Grand Total

SegmentCementSandChipsRodTotal
Concrete quantities use the standard dry-volume method (wet volume × 1.54), 1 bag cement = 1.25 cft. Rod weight uses the standard formula D²/162 kg per meter. This covers main/longitudinal reinforcement only — stirrups/ties are not included. Please verify results before use.

Axial Strength ΦPn (kip)

Theme-matched strength comparison with clearer scale and value formatting.

Axial capacity uses the short tied‑column formula common to BNBC 2020 / ACI 318: ΦPn = 0.80 × 0.65 × [0.85f'c(Ag−Ast) + fy·Ast]. This is pure axial capacity (no bending/slenderness/eccentricity considered) — use it for relative comparison, not final design. Reinforcement ratio (Ast/Ag) should stay within BNBC's 1%–8% range; a warning appears below if a column falls outside it.
